units: Y. Maasr. III, 50ᵈ בית … טובלין לס׳ ולמַשְׁנֶה (not ולא למש׳) school houses for Bible and Talmud make fruits ṭebel for the Bible teacher and for the Talmud teacher. [Perh. to be read: סָפַר Chald. form.]
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:2">Sabb. I, 2</cite> <he>לא ישב אדם לפני הס׳ וכ׳</he> one must not sit down for the hair-cutter near Minḥah time beforesaying the prayer.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:1">Kel. XIII, 1</cite> <he>זוג של ס׳</he> the barbers’ scissors.
